data.narrative:
Poolside is a Series B–stage AI & Software company founded by Jason Warner and Eiso Kant, with $626M raised to date. The valuation framework draws on a peer universe of 4 same-stage private companies in the AI & Software sector (Scale AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, Field AI), alongside 1 public comparable (Palantir).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $626M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B progression, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis calculates the median valuation across the 4-company cohort at $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in market positioning and investor appetite within frontier AI at this stage.

Synthesis across both methods produces a triangulated range of $1.0B to $5.1B, with a median of $2.8B. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound conservatively; the peer median dominates the upper range. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to comparable companies, the specific competitive position within the frontier AI landscape, and whether Poolside's profile resembles lower-valued peers like Field AI or the higher-valued Physical Intelligence cohort. The $3.3B spread underscores the sensitivity to peer selection and stage-appropriate multiplier assumptions.
